about.heading: About Ayden
about.lead: Videographer and cinematographer based in Mankato, Minnesota.
about.portraitAlt: Ayden Jenson, videographer and cinematographer based in Mankato, Minnesota
bio: I make brand films, commercials, and social media content for businesses, along with photography.
I handle the planning, shooting, editing, and color grading myself, which keeps the look consistent from start to finish.
I work with businesses in Mankato, and I'm open to travel. If you have a project in mind, I'd like to hear about it.

services.heading: Full-Scale Video Production, Curated for You
services.lead: Brand films, commercials, and social media content for individuals and businesses located in Minnesota. Open to travel.

items.title: Brand Films
items.summary: Introduce your business, or yourself, in one film.
items.body: People trust what they can see and hear for themselves. A brand film shows your work and your people, so a new customer knows what to expect before they reach out.

items.title: Commercials
items.summary: A video made to sell a product, service, or event.
items.body: A commercial has one job: get the viewer to act. I build it around a single message, so a business can run it in ads or on its own channels.

items.title: Social Media
items.summary: Engaging content geared for short form platforms.
items.body: Regular video keeps your name in front of the people who follow you. I make it fit how people actually watch on their phones.

items.title: Photography
items.summary: People, event, and branding photography that matches the look of your video.
items.body: Stills and motion from the same shoot keep everything you publish looking like it belongs together. Photography can be booked on its own or added to any video project.
